package android.car.remoteaccess {

  public final class CarRemoteAccessManager {
    method @RequiresPermission(android.car.Car.PERMISSION_USE_REMOTE_ACCESS) public void clearRemoteTaskClient();
    method @RequiresPermission(android.car.Car.PERMISSION_USE_REMOTE_ACCESS) public void reportRemoteTaskDone(@NonNull String);
    method @RequiresPermission(android.car.Car.PERMISSION_USE_REMOTE_ACCESS) public void setRemoteTaskClient(@NonNull java.util.concurrent.Executor, @NonNull android.car.remoteaccess.CarRemoteAccessManager.RemoteTaskClientCallback);
  }

  public static interface CarRemoteAccessManager.CompletableRemoteTaskFuture {
    method public void complete();
  }

  public static interface CarRemoteAccessManager.RemoteTaskClientCallback {
    method public void onRegistrationFailed();
    method public void onRegistrationUpdated(@NonNull android.car.remoteaccess.RemoteTaskClientRegistrationInfo);
    method public void onRemoteTaskRequested(@NonNull String, @Nullable byte[], int);
    method @FlaggedApi("android.car.feature.serverless_remote_access") public default void onServerlessClientRegistered();
    method public void onShutdownStarting(@NonNull android.car.remoteaccess.CarRemoteAccessManager.CompletableRemoteTaskFuture);
  }

  public final class RemoteTaskClientRegistrationInfo implements android.os.Parcelable {
    method public int describeContents();
    method @NonNull public String getClientId();
    method @NonNull public String getProcessorId();
    method @NonNull public String getServiceId();
    method @NonNull public String getVehicleId();
    method public void writeToParcel(@NonNull android.os.Parcel, int);
    field @NonNull public static final android.os.Parcelable.Creator<android.car.remoteaccess.RemoteTaskClientRegistrationInfo> CREATOR;
  }

}

package android.car.watchdog {

  public final class CarWatchdogManager {
    method public void addResourceOveruseListener(@NonNull java.util.concurrent.Executor, int, @NonNull android.car.watchdog.CarWatchdogManager.ResourceOveruseListener);
    method @NonNull public android.car.watchdog.ResourceOveruseStats getResourceOveruseStats(int, int);
    method public void removeResourceOveruseListener(@NonNull android.car.watchdog.CarWatchdogManager.ResourceOveruseListener);
    field public static final int FLAG_RESOURCE_OVERUSE_IO = 1; // 0x1
    field public static final int STATS_PERIOD_CURRENT_DAY = 1; // 0x1
    field public static final int STATS_PERIOD_PAST_15_DAYS = 4; // 0x4
    field public static final int STATS_PERIOD_PAST_30_DAYS = 5; // 0x5
    field public static final int STATS_PERIOD_PAST_3_DAYS = 2; // 0x2
    field public static final int STATS_PERIOD_PAST_7_DAYS = 3; // 0x3
  }

  public static interface CarWatchdogManager.ResourceOveruseListener {
    method public void onOveruse(@NonNull android.car.watchdog.ResourceOveruseStats);
  }

  public final class IoOveruseStats implements android.os.Parcelable {
    method public int describeContents();
    method public long getDurationInSeconds();
    method @NonNull public android.car.watchdog.PerStateBytes getRemainingWriteBytes();
    method public long getStartTime();
    method public long getTotalBytesWritten();
    method public long getTotalOveruses();
    method public long getTotalTimesKilled();

    method public void writeToParcel(@NonNull android.os.Parcel, int);
    field @NonNull public static final android.os.Parcelable.Creator<android.car.watchdog.IoOveruseStats> CREATOR;
  }

  public final class PerStateBytes implements android.os.Parcelable {
    ctor public PerStateBytes(long, long, long);
    method public int describeContents();
    method public long getBackgroundModeBytes();
    method public long getForegroundModeBytes();
    method public long getGarageModeBytes();
    method public void writeToParcel(@NonNull android.os.Parcel, int);
    field @NonNull public static final android.os.Parcelable.Creator<android.car.watchdog.PerStateBytes> CREATOR;
  }

  public final class ResourceOveruseStats implements android.os.Parcelable {
    method public int describeContents();
    method @Nullable public android.car.watchdog.IoOveruseStats getIoOveruseStats();
